kuvat.technicalResize: Vain rajaus, Lanczos-suurennus ja PNG/sRGB/tekstimetatiedot. Ei retusointia, sävy- tai sisältömuutosta.
kuvat.generationPrompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate ONE entirely NEW square photographic master image, high resolution preferably2816×2816, opaqueRGB. The user requires ALL images to look as if taken with a real camera. This must look like an actual full-frame colour photograph: believable fabric weave/seams, physical fine ropes, wicker basket, atmospheric haze and natural soft daylight. NO painting, watercolour, drawing, book illustration, paper texture, cartoon, CGI render or stylisation.
Reference image is ONLY the game's balloon-design reference, not an edit target. Recreate its round upper pear-shaped envelope, tapering neck, alternating vertical muted brick-red(#b03a2b) and cream(#faf4d6)fabric gores, sparse thin dark-brown(#46331f)crossing netting and one thin horizontal ring. Keep the long delicate suspension to a separate carrier hoop and a VERY SMALL empty gold-brown wicker basket(#d9a13b/#8a6114). A thin anchor rope trails into haze above the dark footer. No people, burner flames, advertising, text or logos.
EXACT RELATIVE COMPOSITION, irrespective of output pixel count: place the COMPLETE balloon envelope, net, hoop and basket entirely within the CENTRAL26% of canvas width (x37%–63%) and between40% and63% of total canvas HEIGHT. Balloon-and-rigging must be quite small in the square: its TOP begins forty percent DOWN from the upper edge, and the BASKET ends near sixty-three percent. Do not put it near the top or enlarge it. It must stay whole inside both a full-height tall phone crop and a bottom-anchored4:3landscape crop. Top8% is quiet empty sky. Plenty of soft real clouded sky above balloon, not paper.
Background: distant anonymous contemporary European city, hazy modest domes/spires and a few modern plain towers, no identifiable landmark, signage or people. Its subdued silhouette lies around70%–74%height and fades out before75%. Natural calm pale dusty-blue/cream/warm sand atmospheric colour; restrained exposure, no HDR, dramatic cinema glow or oversaturated sunset.
FOOTER: bottom25% of whole square contains NO balloon, rope, building or other detail. Entire width fades smoothly down into near-uniform dark warm-brown#1d1610. Bottom15% must be almost uniformly#1d1610, CIELAB meanL*<=12. No bright speckles or texture there. Straight full-width lower fade, NOT circular vignette, frame or border. No UI, no lettering, no watermarks. Photographic subject and sky, opaquePNG.
